steps.name: locator.getByText('Your request is making it\'s way!').waitFor
Send a message from first user to second user
Validate Pinned Messages container is empty when no messages have been pinned
Local user can pin a message
Open Pinned Messages container on local side and validate message is displayed
Validate remote message pinned by remote user
Local user can unpin a message
Send a second message from first user to second user
Validate user can pin a remote message
Open Pinned Messages container on local side and validate message is displayed
Validate remote user can unpin a message from context menu
Send a third message from second user to first user
Validate local user can pin a message
Validate local user can unpin a message from unpin button
locator.click([data-cy="pinned-message"] >> internal:has="internal:text=\"this is a third test message\"i" >> [data-cy="pinned-message-button-unpin"])
Send a fourth message from first user to second user
Validate that remote user can pin a message
Validate that remote user can unpin a message from unpin button
locator.click([data-cy="pinned-message"] >> internal:has="internal:text=\"this is a fourth test message\"i" >> [data-cy="pinned-message-button-unpin"])
Validate after all messages are unpinned, Pinned Messages container is empty again on both sides
